_doc: Battle rule tables (KAMPF_PLAN_1000 item 976), read once by scripts/battle/BattleRules.gd into TRAITS, FIELDS, REACTIONS, RULES and BOSSES. Data only: KampfChecks inside DataValidator checks every field and boss, and battle data packs (BattlePacks.gd, items 991, 992) may add entries but never change one. Keep the key order: the seeded field pick walks FIELDS in this order. Player texts (label, text, intro, line, full_text) are English; German goes into a tools/i18n/de_*.py table.
_traits: Passive gifts, one per species (spirlings.json trait). scorch_atk: Might multiplier while Scorched; phys_taken: multiplier on physical damage taken; regen_div: heal max Vigor / div at turn end; energy_per_turn: extra Energy each turn; immune: statuses that cannot be applied; low_hp_boost: own-element damage below 1/3 Vigor; field_proof: a field never weakens its arts; field_energy: Energy when a new field is laid; contact_status, contact_chance: status passed to a physical attacker; cure_on_swap: status falls away on the bench; cost_cut_from: arts costing at least this cost 1 less; full_energy_mult: damage with a full Energy bar.
_fields: Rift fields. A map sets field; a Resonance art lays one for a few turns. boost, weaken: elements; blocks: statuses that cannot take hold; regen_element, regen_div: that element heals max Vigor / div per turn; rest_bonus: extra Energy per Rest; energy_element, energy_gain: extra Energy per turn for that element; bond_bonus: added to the Echo call chance; cheap_element: arts of that element cost BattleRules.FIELD_COST_CUT less while the field is the place's own.
_reactions: Element reactions: an art of element hitting a foe with status hits harder (mult), washes the status off (cure), may give a new one (inflict) and/or moves a stage (stage). At most one per hit: the first row that fits wins, no two rows share a pair.
_rules: Warden rules (npc rule). foe_energy, foe_energy_every, player_stage, lead_only, difficulty (GameState order the rule may be used on), warden_only, field_opening, field_cycle, turning (the turning point block), accuracy_mult, vine_heal_div, hidden_order, sand_chip_div, heal_mult, lumen_mult, player_energy_cut, stages_locked, rest_cut, no_status. Keys ending in _mult multiply over stacked rules, the others add up (BattleRules.rule_number).
_bosses: Rift bosses (npc boss). hp_per_ally: max Vigor multiplier per player Spirling on the field; max_actions: actions per turn with 4 fielded; phase: second phase with at (share of max Vigor), stage changes, an existing field and a text.

kindling.label: Kindling
kindling.text: Scorch raises its Might instead of lowering it.

thick_hide.label: Thick Hide
thick_hide.text: Takes 15% less damage from physical arts.

deep_roots.label: Deep Roots
deep_roots.text: Recovers a little Vigor at the end of each turn.

last_stand.label: Last Stand
last_stand.text: Its own element hits 30% harder below 1/3 Vigor.

field_strider.label: Field Strider
field_strider.text: A Rift field never weakens its arts.

echo_soul.label: Echo Soul
echo_soul.text: Gains 2 Energy whenever a new Rift field is laid.

glimmer_skin.label: Glimmer Skin
glimmer_skin.text: A physical hit on it may Scorch whoever struck it (3 in 10).

unruffled.label: Unruffled
unruffled.text: Its status falls away when it steps back to your side.

low_flame.label: Low Flame
low_flame.text: Arts that cost 5 Energy or more cost 1 less.

overflow.label: Overflow
overflow.text: Hits 10% harder while its Energy is full.

ash_storm.label: Ash Storm
ash_storm.intro: Ash swirls through the Rift. Ember arts burn brighter, Tide arts sputter.

high_tide.label: High Tide
high_tide.intro: The water rises around you. Tide arts surge, Ember arts fizzle, and nothing catches fire.

deep_murk.label: Deep Murk
deep_murk.intro: The hollow swallows the light. Umbra arts deepen, Lumen arts dim.

static_veil.label: Static Veil
static_veil.intro: The air crackles. Volt arts snap harder, Stone arts crumble.

pollen_drift.label: Pollen Drift
pollen_drift.intro: Pollen drifts through the Rift. Bloom arts flourish and Bloom Spirlings mend, Gale arts stall.

dawn_glow.label: Dawn Glow
dawn_glow.intro: A pale dawn fills the Rift. Lumen arts shine, Umbra arts thin out.

rubble_rain.label: Rubble Rain
rubble_rain.intro: Grit and pebbles patter down. Stone arts land heavier, Volt arts ground out, and no charge can build.

gale_eye.label: Gale Eye
gale_eye.intro: The wind circles the Rift and holds its breath in the middle. Gale arts cut sharper, Bloom arts wilt, and nobody can doze off.

rust_haze.label: Rust Haze
rust_haze.intro: Red flakes hang in the damp air. Rust arts bite deeper, Gilt arts tarnish.

ink_flood.label: Ink Flood
ink_flood.intro: Ink seeps up from the ground and swallows every shape. Ink arts spread, Lumen arts drown.

rime_fall.label: Rime Fall
rime_fall.intro: Rime drifts down and settles on every edge. Frost arts cut colder, Ember arts gutter out.

gilt_glare.label: Gilt Glare
gilt_glare.intro: Light bounces off gilded stone. Gilt arts gleam, Rust arts flake away.

reactions.text: The charge races through the soaked %s!
The water douses the embers on %s!
The stone grounds the charge in %s!
The gust blows %s dry, and it slows down!
The flames burn the roots off %s, and it catches fire!

ember_pulse.label: Ember Pulse
ember_pulse.text: The foe's Spirlings gain 1 extra Energy every turn.

turning.text: The pulse flares: the foe's Spirlings gain 1 Energy at once.
turning.full_text: The pulse quickens: now 2 extra Energy every turn.
turning.line: One left? Then the embers burn for both of us!

undertow.label: Undertow
undertow.text: The current drags at you: your Spirlings start with less Pace.

turning.text: The current deepens: your next Spirling to come in loses Might.
turning.line: The tide turns. Whoever you send next, it pulls under!

ember_pulse_soft.label: Ember Pulse
ember_pulse_soft.text: The foe's Spirlings gain 1 extra Energy every second turn.

undertow_soft.label: Undertow
undertow_soft.text: The current drags at your lead: it starts with less Pace.

ash_rain.label: Ash Rain
ash_rain.text: Ash rains down: for 3 turns the Ash Storm can't be called away.

tide_turn.label: Tide Turn
tide_turn.text: The tide comes and goes: High Tide for 2 turns, then 2 turns of calm.

fog_bank.label: Fog Bank
fog_bank.text: Thick fog: every art on both sides is less accurate.

vine_tangle.label: Vine Tangle
vine_tangle.text: Vines creep in: each round they mend the weakest Spirling in front.

night_dark.label: Night Dark
night_dark.text: In the dark nobody sees who moves first: Pace no longer sets the order.

sandstorm.label: Sandstorm
sandstorm.text: Sand howls through the wind towers: every Spirling in front that is not Stone loses a little Vigor each round.

dry_well.label: Dry Well
dry_well.text: The oasis has been sold dry: every heal on both sides is halved.

high_noon.label: High Noon
high_noon.text: The sun stands straight overhead: Lumen arts on both sides hit harder.

low_tide.label: Low Tide
low_tide.text: The water has drawn back: your Spirlings start with 1 Energy less.

still_air.label: Still Air
still_air.text: Not a breath of wind: no stat stage rises or falls on either side.

ebb.label: Ebb
ebb.text: The water has run out: resting gives 1 Energy less on both sides.

hushed_air.label: Hushed Air
hushed_air.text: The air hangs dead still: no status takes hold on either side.

ashen_heart.label: Ashen Heart
ashen_heart.text: The Hush gathers into one burning heart. It is far too strong to face alone!

phase.text: The Ashen Heart flares up! Its embers spin faster.

drowned_heart.label: Drowned Heart
drowned_heart.text: The Rift's water heaves up around a drowned heart. Its guard stands beside it!

phase.text: The Drowned Heart pulls the tide around itself!

mist_heart.label: Mist Heart
mist_heart.text: The fog knots itself into one grey heart. It drifts at you from every side!

phase.text: The Mist Heart crackles! Lightning flickers in the fog.
